question: The award given to the coaches of sports and games in India is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dronacharya Award**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dronacharya Award** is given to outstanding coaches in sports and games in India.
 
• The award was instituted in **1985** by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• It is named after **Dronacharya**, a character from the Indian epic Mahabharata who was a master of advanced military arts.
 
• The award carries a **bronze statuette of Dronacharya, a certificate, ceremonial dress, and a cash prize**.
 
• Recipients of the award are selected based on their performance and contribution to the promotion of sports and coaching excellence in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arjuna Award** is another prestigious sports award in India, given to athletes for their outstanding achievements in national sports.
 
• The **Vir Chakra** is a military decoration awarded for acts of bravery on the battlefield.
 
• The **Golden Boot** is an award given to the top goal scorer in a football league or tournament.
 
• The Dronacharya Award aims to recognize and honor the hard work and dedication of coaches who play a crucial role in shaping the careers of athletes.
 
• Recipients of the Dronacharya Award have included coaches from various sports disciplines, such as athletics, boxing, wrestling, and cricket.
